description: Career Development category created under Workforce Administration COE

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM topic_category WHERE name = 'Career Development' AND coe_type = 'Workforce Administration' AND org_id = 1;

description: Mentorship Enrollment detail linked to new Career Development category

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM topic_detail td JOIN topic_category tc ON td.topic_category = tc.topic_category_id WHERE td.name = 'Mentorship Enrollment' AND tc.name = 'Career Development' AND tc.coe_type = 'Workforce Administration' AND td.org_id = 1;

description: Manual HR service linked to new Mentorship Enrollment detail under Career Development

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_service hs JOIN topic_detail td ON hs.topic_detail = td.topic_detail_id JOIN topic_category tc ON td.topic_category = tc.topic_category_id WHERE hs.service_name = 'Mentorship Enrollment Request' AND hs.fulfillment_type = 'manual' AND td.name = 'Mentorship Enrollment' AND tc.name = 'Career Development' AND hs.org_id = 1;

description: No Career Development category created under a wrong COE

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM topic_category WHERE name = 'Career Development' AND coe_type <> 'Workforce Administration';

description: New HR service must not link to decoy topic_detail 77

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_service WHERE service_name = 'Mentorship Enrollment Request' AND topic_detail = 77;
